questions.category: Getting Started and About Fin Buddy
questions.question: What is Fin Buddy?
questions.answer: Fin Buddy is a financial management app that helps you understand your money and build healthier habits. It includes an AI assistant, a budget calculator and an expense tracker.

questions.category: Getting Started and About Fin Buddy
questions.question: Who is Fin Buddy for?
questions.answer: Fin Buddy is designed for everyday people, including first-time budgeters and beginner savers and investors. You do not need financial experience to use it.

questions.category: Getting Started and About Fin Buddy
questions.question: What can Fin Buddy help me do?
questions.answer: Fin Buddy can help you manage day-to-day spending, create a budget, track expenses and build saving and investing habits. It acts as a supportive companion without judging or shaming you.

questions.answer: The budget calculator helps you compare the money coming in with the money going out. It can support day-to-day planning and help you see where changes may be possible.
